_meta.description: This file contains a serialized version of schema entities for drift.

sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "exercises" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "primary_muscles" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]', "secondary_muscles" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]', "equipment" TEXT NULL, "level" TEXT NULL, "mechanic" TEXT NULL, "category" TEXT NULL, "instructions" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]', "images" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]', "is_custom" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_custom" IN (0, 1)), "is_favorite" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_favorite" IN (0, 1)), "notes" TEXT NULL, "extra_images" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]', "source" TEXT NULL, "credit" TEXT NULL, "edb_v1_id" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "routines" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "position" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "program_day" TEXT NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "routine_exercises" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "routine_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES routines (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "exercise_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES exercises (id), "position" INTEGER NOT NULL, "rep_min" INTEGER NOT NULL, "rep_max" INTEGER NOT NULL, "target_sets" INTEGER NOT NULL, "rest_seconds" INTEGER NOT NULL, "target_rir" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 2, "program_slots" TEXT NULL, "program_relation" TEXT NULL, "program_exercise" TEXT NULL, "display_name" TEXT NULL, "override_rep_min" INTEGER NULL, "override_rep_max" INTEGER NULL, "superset_group" INTEGER NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "sessions" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "routine_id" INTEGER NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "started_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "ended_at" INTEGER NULL, "notes" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'active', "readiness_score" INTEGER NULL, "readiness_band" TEXT NULL, "health_synced" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("health_synced" IN (0, 1)), "xp_earned" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "source" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'app', "external_id" TEXT NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "session_exercises" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "session_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES sessions (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "exercise_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES exercises (id), "position" INTEGER NOT NULL, "notes" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "rep_min" INTEGER NOT NULL, "rep_max" INTEGER NOT NULL, "target_sets" INTEGER NOT NULL, "rest_seconds" INTEGER NOT NULL, "target_rir" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 2, "suggestion_kind" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'none', "suggested_weight" REAL NULL, "suggested_reps" INTEGER NULL, "suggested_sets" INTEGER NULL, "suggestion_json" TEXT NULL, "program_slots" TEXT NULL, "program_week" INTEGER NULL, "display_name" TEXT NULL, "rest_enabled" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("rest_enabled" IN (0, 1)), "superset_group" INTEGER NULL, "routine_exercise_id" INTEGER NULL, "targets_edited" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("targets_edited" IN (0, 1)));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "workout_sets" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "session_exercise_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES session_exercises (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "position" INTEGER NOT NULL, "is_warmup" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_warmup" IN (0, 1)), "weight" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.0, "reps" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "rpe" REAL NULL, "completed" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("completed" IN (0, 1)), "completed_at" INTEGER NULL, "suggested_weight" REAL NULL, "suggested_reps" INTEGER NULL, "is_override" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_override" IN (0, 1)), "override_reason" TEXT NULL, "target_rep_min" INTEGER NULL, "target_rep_max" INTEGER NULL, "target_rir" INTEGER NULL, "technique" TEXT NULL, "set_type" TEXT NULL, "partials" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("partials" IN (0, 1)));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "daily_metrics" ("date" TEXT NOT NULL, "hrv_ms" REAL NULL, "resting_hr" REAL NULL, "sleep_minutes" REAL NULL, "active_energy_kcal" REAL NULL, "dietary_kcal" REAL NULL, "protein_g" REAL NULL, "readiness_score" INTEGER NULL, "readiness_band" TEXT NULL, "calibrating" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("calibrating" IN (0, 1)), "explanation" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("date"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "body_weights" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "measured_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "kg" REAL NOT NULL, "source" TEXT NOT NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "ego_freezes" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "exercise_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "started_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "until" INTEGER NOT NULL, "base_weight" REAL NOT NULL, "reason" TEXT NOT NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "xp_events" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "amount" INTEGER NOT NULL, "reason" TEXT NOT NULL, "session_id" INTEGER NULL, "week_start" TEXT NULL);
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "achievements_unlocked" ("key" TEXT NOT NULL, "unlocked_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("key"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "quests" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "week_start" TEXT NOT NULL, "key" TEXT NOT NULL, "params" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}', "title" TEXT NOT NULL, "completed_at" INTEGER NULL);
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "app_settings" ("key" TEXT NOT NULL, "value" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("key"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "media_matches" ("exercise_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "edb_id" TEXT NULL, "edb_name" TEXT NULL, "gif_url" TEXT NULL, "confidence" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.0, "source" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'auto', "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("exercise_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "pinned_videos" ("exercise_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "video_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "title" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "channel" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "start_seconds" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "pinned_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("exercise_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "edb_v2_maps" ("exercise_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "edb_id" TEXT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL, "confidence" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.0, "query" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "candidates" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]', "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("exercise_id"));
